assignment.instruction: Find the shortest-path distance in edges from you to D in the communication graph. Submit an integer.

cases.rules: You are one vertex of a static, simple, connected, undirected graph. All vertices share reward 1 for success, otherwise 0. Names identify the same vertices throughout this episode. You initially know only the roster and YOUR immediate neighbours. Graph edges are exactly the available pair chats. One vertex initially receives the task; other vertices must learn what is needed through messages. Initially only the task holder is active. Other vertices wait automatically until their first incoming message; after that they may freely send, answer if authorised, or wait. You are called only when active. Choose exactly ONE tool {"id":NAME,"args":ARGUMENTS} per tick: send_message, wait, or an available answer tool. send_message(chat_id,content) publishes exactly that text to that pair chat after one tick. Only explicit sends deliver text; your reasoning and private observations are never automatically shared. A message selected in the current tick is first readable in the NEXT tick. You may send to one neighbour per tick. Simultaneous sends by different vertices are allowed. Read your accessible chat histories and retain your own knowledge. Waiting consumes one tick. Use only the tools present in your observation. Invalid calls end the episode. Message allowance is at least the episode horizon, so it adds no restriction beyond one tool per tick. No protocol or solution is supplied. There is no pre-game discussion.

One vertex initially receives the task; other vertices must learn what is needed through messages. Initially only the task holder is active. Other vertices wait automatically until their first incoming message; after that they may freely send, answer if authorised, or wait. You are called only when active. Choose exactly ONE tool {"id":NAME,"args":ARGUMENTS} per tick: send_message, wait, or an available answer tool. send_message(chat_id,content) publishes exactly that text to that pair chat after one tick. Only explicit sends deliver text; your reasoning and private observations are never automatically shared. A message selected in the current tick is first readable in the NEXT tick. You may send to one neighbour per tick. Simultaneous sends by different vertices are allowed. Read your accessible chat histories and retain your own knowledge. Waiting consumes one tick. Use only the tools present in your observation. Invalid calls end the episode. Message allowance is at least the episode horizon, so it adds no restriction beyond one tool per tick. No protocol or solution is supplied. There is no pre-game discussion.

description: В начале задание известно только A. Другие вершины начинают действовать после первого входящего сообщения. За такт можно отправить сообщение одному соседу, подождать или, для A, дать окончательный ответ.
Сообщения доставляются через один такт. Имена соседей доступны владельцу, полный граф включается только в режиме исследователя.
